title: Warm Flaky Filipino Coconut Leche Flan
description: A jammy and flaky post-workout Filipino dessert featuring gelatine leafs and pickle, made FODMAP-friendly in a dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium saucepan, combine the coconut milk, sugar, and salt, and heat over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, coconut oil, and vanilla extract.
Add the soaked gelatine leafs to the egg mixture and whisk until dissolved.
Strain the coconut milk mixture into the egg mixture and whisk until smooth.
Pour the mixture into 4 dolsot stone bowls.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
